scientific_integrity: An algebraic four-stratum proof establishes the all-field statement. Direct matrix multiplication in two finite fields is corroboration, not an infinite-field proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the 4-by-4 upper-unitriangular group, even field orders; restricted centralizers among elements with square one, not full group centralizers.
The 2005 Isaacs–Karagueuzian and 2016 Basili full papers could not be inspected; historical priority of the explicit two-point census remains provisional.
Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Commuting involution strata in four-by-four unitriangular algebra groups
